g.text: CONNECTED I2C DESIGN - labels with matching names connect electrically. PCB has airwires; routing remains to be designed.

g.text: Fit at most ONE verified 5 V BEC link JP1-JP4. Remove all links before USB powering. Motor current stays on separate power distribution.
